entry.title: New: RES25-048 (Honolulu) — CCL
entry.content:
URGING THE CITY ADMINISTRATION TO CREATE AN OʻAHU TOURISM STRATEGIC PLAN THAT PRIORITIZES REGENERATIVE AND SUSTAINABLE TOURISM, RESPECT FOR NATIVE HAWAIIAN CULTURE AND VLAUES, THE INTEGRATION OF EMERGING TECHNOLOGIES, AND FORWARD-THINKING ECONOMIC STRATEGIES.

Latest action: Committee report and Resolution as amended were adopted.
